biography:
With over 20 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, I am a passionate and results-oriented Director of Sales at Prime Data Centers, a company that designs, builds, and manages data centers and data center infrastructure globally. My mission is to help clients achieve their business goals by providing them with innovative and customized data center solutions that meet their current and future needs.

As a sales leader, I leverage my strong relationship management, communication, and presentation skills to generate new business opportunities, expand existing accounts, and negotiate profitable contracts. I have successfully closed deals with some of the top data center buyers and operators in the industry, contributing to the growth and development of Prime's portfolio. I also collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality service and customer satisfaction. I am always eager to learn new trends and technologies in the data center space and share my insights and expertise with others.
